description: Create, update, or delete project releases with asset management. Actions: create (release from tag with notes/assets), update (modify metadata), delete (remove release, tag preserved), create_link (add asset URL), delete_link (remove asset). Related: browse_releases for discovery.

action.description: Action to perform: create, update, delete, create_link, delete_link

assets.description: Release assets configuration Required for 'create' action(s).

links.description: Asset links to create with the release

direct_asset_path.description: Path for direct asset download (creates permanent URL)

name.description: Display name for the asset link

description.description: Release description (supports Markdown) Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

direct_asset_path.description: Path for direct asset download (e.g., '/binaries/linux-amd64') Required for 'create_link' action(s).

link_id.description: The ID of the asset link to delete Required for 'delete_link' action(s).

link_type.description: Type of asset link (default: other) Required for 'create_link' action(s).

milestones.description: Array of milestone titles to associate with the release Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

name.description: Display name for the asset link (must be unique per release) Required for 'create', 'update', 'create_link' action(s).

ref.description: Branch/commit SHA to create tag from (if tag does not exist) Required for 'create' action(s).

released_at.description: Release date/time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T12:00:00Z') Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

tag_message.description: Annotation message for the tag (creates annotated tag) Required for 'create' action(s).

tag_name.description: The Git tag associated with the release (e.g., 'v1.0.0')

url.description: URL of the asset (must be unique per release) Required for 'create_link' action(s).

name: manage_release
